6559.title: Git index-copy fallback rejects non-directory index paths
6559.rootCauseOneLine: The optional index copy handles ENOENT but propagates ENOTDIR when the resolved index path is beneath a regular marker file.
6559.proposedFix: Treat ENOTDIR like ENOENT at the index-stat boundary and retain propagation for other filesystem errors. A 37-line two-file candidate passes the focused regression and all 250 Git plugin tests.
6559.caveats: Reproduced the production host path with real Git and filesystem plus an index-location shim; no live third-party machine or downstream cleanup UI was tested.
